test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct spelling from the given options to fill in the blank.

Mihika was one of the _______________ in the Master Chef competition held in our society last year.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"contestant"** refers to a person who takes part in a contest or competition. It implies participation in an event where skills, ability, or merit is tested. (प्रतियोगी)

 
 
• **Example: **Every contestant in the spelling bee had studied hard, hoping to win the trophy.
 
 

 
• Therefore, in the sentence, it suggests Mihika was a participant or competitor in the Master Chef competition. (प्रतियोगी)
